problem_title: The mind stays “on the run” long after the danger has passed.
problem_1_text: Thoughts that won't stop, hard to fall asleep, hard to stay focused on a single task.
problem_2_text: You wake up tired even after 7–8 hours in bed; sleep no longer restores you.
problem_3_text: The body stays on watch long after the cause of the stress has gone.
method_line: Each ear hears a slightly different tone; the brain puts the difference back together.
method_step_1: Through headphones, the left ear hears one tone and the right ear another, very close in frequency.
method_step_2: This is called a binaural beat: the brain perceives a third tone that does not physically exist outside it.
method_note: That is why headphones are needed: speakers mix the two tones before they reach your ears.
sample_text: A demo made by the EQ-SYNC team so you can hear the binaural effect: it is not a session from the protocol. Put on headphones.
sample_note: Sound starts only when you press play.
sample_heard: What you will hear: one low tone in each ear, slowly drawing closer. The difference between them starts at 10 pulses a second and falls towards 6 over the two minutes. Underneath, the sound of distant waves coming in and going out. It begins quietly and fades the same way, with no sudden sounds.
sample_safety: Headphones only. Never while driving or operating machinery. If you have epilepsy or another seizure disorder, speak to your doctor first. Stop if you feel uncomfortable.

guide_intro: Good evening. I'm the EQ-SYNC guide. Tell me what you're looking for, calm in the evening, sleep or clarity, and I'll show you how you can start with the free 21-day programme.

faq_1_a: Only headphones, with separate left and right sound. Speakers don't work: the binaural effect depends on each ear receiving its own tone.
faq_2_a: You put on headphones, find a quiet place and listen to a guided exercise at your own pace. The free programme has 4 exercises, which you can repeat any time during the 21 days.
faq_3_q: What happens after the 21 free days?
faq_3_a: The 4 free exercises close after day 21, and you get an email beforehand. The bonus exercise “Deep relaxation”, unlocked on day 20, stays yours. If you want to go on, you choose protocols.
faq_4_q: Is it a medical device or a treatment?
faq_4_a: No. EQ-SYNC is a wellness tool, not a medical device, and it does not replace medical advice or treatment.
faq_5_a: Yes. People with epilepsy or seizure disorders should not use binaural audio without their doctor's approval.
